title: Source baseline and capability truth — functional
requirement: Every capability has a dated source and an evidence type.

title: Source baseline and capability truth — truth
requirement: Partial/historical source reads do not become current verdicts.

title: Source baseline and capability truth — integration
requirement: Private evidence remains private; report-only and public artifact states differ.

title: Brand language and naming system — functional
requirement: Naming matches the approved map except documented execution-time conflicts.

title: Brand language and naming system — truth
requirement: No unsupported win, 24/7 autonomy, universal integration, or legal-clearance claims.

title: Brand language and naming system — integration
requirement: Audience and developer copy each identify what is actually available.

title: Design tokens and Astra-generated identity — functional
requirement: Mark reads at 16, 24, and 48 px and in monochrome. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Design tokens and Astra-generated identity — truth
requirement: Text is deterministic, accurate, and accessible. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Design tokens and Astra-generated identity — integration
requirement: No bundled font binaries or ambiguous copied marks. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Artwork masters, exports, and provenance — functional
requirement: Every required export has source, digest, placement, alt/decorative treatment, and review. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Artwork masters, exports, and provenance — truth
requirement: Captured evidence is not replaced by generated fake screenshots. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Artwork masters, exports, and provenance — integration
requirement: Missing access blocks exact asset IDs rather than being called delivered. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: Watch, Runs, Build, and Docs experience — functional
requirement: No placeholder or unavailable primary destinations.

title: Watch, Runs, Build, and Docs experience — truth
requirement: Keyboard/mobile/light/dark/reduced-motion states are inspected.

title: Watch, Runs, Build, and Docs experience — integration
requirement: Synthetic fixtures cannot enter the production export.

title: Subscription, deployment compatibility, and privacy — functional
requirement: Tests cover successful, duplicate, throttled, malformed, failed-mail, and concurrent requests.

title: Subscription, deployment compatibility, and privacy — truth
requirement: No emails, tokens, paths, or raw IPs leak into public logs or client responses.

title: Subscription, deployment compatibility, and privacy — integration
requirement: No production mail is sent without scoped permission.

title: Organization and component presentation — functional
requirement: Flagship is obvious and commands actually work in the stated test environment.

title: Organization and component presentation — truth
requirement: Old historical evidence and upstream attribution are preserved.

title: Organization and component presentation — integration
requirement: Settings actions are separated from source edits and performed only with authority.

title: Idempotent rename and legacy-route operations — functional
requirement: Dry run detects collision, stale ID/head, hosted Actions consumers, and unauthorized operation.

title: Idempotent rename and legacy-route operations — truth
requirement: Old names are not recreated; Pages history survives.

title: Idempotent rename and legacy-route operations — integration
requirement: Repeated apply does not duplicate or undo completed operations.

title: Sanitized run publication and deterministic exports — functional
requirement: Unapproved/private/synthetic/forced-fixture inputs fail production publication.

title: Sanitized run publication and deterministic exports — truth
requirement: Mutation authority never crosses into the public publisher.

title: Sanitized run publication and deterministic exports — integration
requirement: Changed source digest invalidates prior approval.

title: Capabilities, event contracts, and comparison context — functional
requirement: No raw email, private prompts, game secrets, or fingerprinting in events.

title: Capabilities, event contracts, and comparison context — truth
requirement: Source report, independent reproduction, and release support are distinct.

title: Capabilities, event contracts, and comparison context — integration
requirement: Game failure and infrastructure failure never silently share a denominator.

title: Launch kit and twelve-week production calendar — functional
requirement: Every factual claim maps to approved sources; unavailable material is explicitly gated.

title: Launch kit and twelve-week production calendar — truth
requirement: Series depicts actual attempts, interventions, and outcomes without invented evidence.

title: Launch kit and twelve-week production calendar — integration
requirement: A content calendar is not reported as an operated campaign.

title: Creator partnerships, distribution experiments, and contributions — functional
requirement: No fabricated partners, testimonials, followers, paid votes, or undisclosed influence.

title: Creator partnerships, distribution experiments, and contributions — truth
requirement: Each experiment has hypothesis, denominator, stop criteria, and result placeholders labeled unobserved.

title: Creator partnerships, distribution experiments, and contributions — integration
requirement: Messages remain drafts unless publication/sending is actually authorized.

title: Cross-surface test suite and adversarial review — functional
requirement: Actual commands, versions, revisions, rendered outputs, and failures are recorded.

title: Cross-surface test suite and adversarial review — truth
requirement: No skipped host/browser/model checks become a pass.

title: Cross-surface test suite and adversarial review — integration
requirement: Reviewer independence and a genuine depth-three chain are evidenced.

title: Release engineering and operator handoff — functional
requirement: Local, merged, deployed, and campaign-operated states are separate.

title: Release engineering and operator handoff — truth
requirement: Every mandatory requirement and asset is verified or specifically blocked.

title: Release engineering and operator handoff — integration
requirement: No remote action or success is claimed without returned evidence.

title: Preserve fixed identity
requirement: Organization remains AI Ascension, flagship Ascension, series The Climb; refresh first-win season only with new evidence.

title: Read current heads
requirement: Capture complete current source inventory, stable repository IDs, default branches, open PRs, and deployment branches before edits.

title: All assets
requirement: Every mandatory registry asset and export is actually produced or specifically blocked, with source, review, and license information. All artwork is generated exclusively by gpt-image-2 from an actual Astra-authored prompt; no code-drawn or legacy-art substitute.

title: No font binaries
requirement: The prompt handoff and final asset delivery archives contain no font binaries; use existing licensed website assets or reference-only notices.

title: Genuine capture
requirement: No synthetic screenshots, generated gameplay results, or fabricated endorsement marks are used as real evidence.

title: Working primary journey
requirement: A visitor can reach actual available run content and a tested developer starting point without dead primary CTAs.

title: Legacy proof preservation
requirement: Old GitHub Pages proof paths, named fixtures, hashes, and historical anchors remain available or explicitly preserved.

title: Mail safety
requirement: Subscription confirmation, unsubscribe, failure behavior, and concurrent persistence are tested without unauthorized production messages.

title: Compatibility preservation
requirement: Initial presentation rename does not change runtime binary/package/environment/schema identities.

title: Active work compatibility
requirement: The map visualizer rename does not break active instructions requiring its current name; coordinate before authorized cutover.

title: Private record boundary
requirement: Publication reads approved sanitized copies; no game mutation interface or private observability UI is exposed.

title: Approval invalidation
requirement: Source content changes invalidate approval by digest; synthetic or forced-fixture results fail normal production publication.

title: Complete calendar
requirement: Deliver 12 episode briefs, 24 short-clip briefs, 6 technical article outlines, first launch copy, report-only alternatives, and outreach/email templates.

title: Honest measurement
requirement: Audience and developer metrics have denominators and distinct real/synthetic/infrastructure-failure accounting; no fabricated results.

title: Role-specific Luna/Astra runtime evidence
requirement: All descendants have role-correct requested/accepted/observed model and effort records: 47 Luna/max roles and two Astra/max art-author roles; no substitutions or self-report verification.

title: Native depth evidence
requirement: At least one substantive real root→lead→coordinator→leaf chain is evidenced, no leaf children exist, and the global open ceiling holds.

title: Release authorization
requirement: Every external rename, merge, deployment, publication, and send is performed only within actual scope and has a verifiable receipt.

title: Final states
requirement: Implemented, verified, merged, deployed, and campaign-operated states remain distinct in the final report.

title: Astra authorship
requirement: Every initial generation prompt and creative edit prompt has an actual gpt-6-astra/max native-agent record, exact prompt bytes, SHA-256, and independent review.

title: Exact image model
requirement: Every artwork generation requests gpt-image-2; actual model evidence resolves to gpt-image-2 or a documented verified snapshot, never an unknown or alternate backend.

title: No creative fallback
requirement: SVG/Canvas/CSS/Python drawing, stock art, tracing, unmodified legacy artwork, alternate image models, and silent substitution fail artwork acceptance.

title: Complete art inventory
requirement: All 72 new-artwork families use the generation-only registry; the three evidence-media families and five historical/reference records remain separately classified.

title: Per-export lineage
requirement: Every artwork export links to a reviewed original gpt-image-2 output and its Astra prompt; only enumerated noncreative transformations are allowed.

title: Text and data verification
requirement: Logos, typography, diagrams and charts are generated with gpt-image-2, checked against exact copy/source facts, and corrected only by an Astra-authored generation/edit.

title: Evidence isolation
requirement: No generated or generatively retouched image/video is accepted as genuine gameplay evidence. Generated posters and diagrams remain labeled presentation art.

title: No render-time image calls
requirement: Approved art is precomputed and content-addressed; page load, rebuild, and serving make no implicit Astra/image calls. New creative variants are explicit jobs.

title: No fourth agent layer
requirement: The two Astra art authors are depth-3 leaves under W02; image generation is a tool invocation, and no leaf spawns another agent.

title: Block missing models precisely
requirement: Unavailable Astra/gpt-image-2 or missing native attestation blocks exact asset IDs; unrelated engineering continues and no fallback receives a verified flag.
